title: From dosage alteration to amplification strategies: mechanistically defined alpha-synuclein mouse models for Parkinson’s disease therapy development
title_zh: 从剂量调整到放大策略：用于帕金森病治疗开发的机制定义α-突触核蛋白小鼠模型
abstract: A major challenge for identifying a disease-modifying cure for Parkinson's disease (PD) is creating models resembling key features of the disease including resting tremor, bradykinesia, muscle rigidity and gait disturbances. In addition, PD patients often develop cognitive symptoms that are associated with pathology in neocortical areas. Initially, PD rodent models were generated primarily by chemical neurotoxins that induce an acute loss of dopaminergic neurons. Upon discovery of familial-PD-linked genetic mutations in the SNCA gene-encoding α-synuclein (αS)-mice carrying these mutations provided deeper insight into the pathologic role of this synaptic protein throughout the brain. αS transgenic mouse models stand out for their ability to develop intraneuronal lesions that are rich in αS phospho-serine 129, a histopathological signature of the human PD brain. Recent advances in αS protein biochemistry led to the generation of mice carrying strategic amplifications of familial-PD-linked αS mutants, resulting in more pronounced neurodegeneration and progressive phenotype development. Here we review advances of αS transgenic mouse model development with a focus on strategic mutations that may have greater potential for identifying underlying disease mechanisms than classical single-mutant and wild-type αS overexpressing mice. We also present how the mice are currently used in testing drug efficacy and target engagement for PD drug discovery and outline strategies for utilizing such mice in basic and translational research.
abstract_zh: 识别帕金森病（PD）的病理修饰性治愈方法的主要挑战在于创建模仿疾病关键特征的模型，包括静息震颤、运动迟缓、肌肉僵硬和步态障碍。此外，PD患者常出现与新皮质区病理相关的认知症状。最初，PD啮齿类模型主要是由诱导多巴胺神经元急性丧失的化学神经毒素生成的。在家族性PD相关基因突变在SNCA基因中被发现编码α-突触核蛋白（αS）后，携带这些突变的小鼠提供了关于这种突触蛋白在整个大脑中病理角色的更深入见解。αS转基因小鼠模型因其能够发育出富含αS磷酸丝氨酸129的细胞内病变而脱颖而出，这是人类PD大脑的组织病理学标志。αS蛋白生物化学的最新进展导致产生携带家族性PD相关αS突变的战略性放大的小鼠，从而导致更明显的神经退行性变和进行性表型发展。本文综述了αS转基因小鼠模型的发展进展，重点关注可能比经典单突变和野生型αS过表达小鼠具有更大潜力的战略性突变，以识别潜在的疾病机制。此外，我们还介绍了这些小鼠目前如何用于测试药物疗效和PD药物发现的靶点结合，并概述了在基础和转化研究中利用此类小鼠的策略。
